description: Upload a design file (STEP/STP, IGES/IGS, STL, 3MF, OBJ, DXF, DWG, PDF, ZIP (Gerber files go in a ZIP); up to 6 MB as base64 here, up to 100 MB with POST /api/v1/rfq/files?name=...). Returns a file_id to pass in create_rfq file_ids. Unused files expire after 24 hours. Only upload files the user agreed to share with manufacturers.

name.description: File name with extension, e.g. bracket.step

rfq_id.description: Optional: attach to an existing request (needs token)

token.description: The rfq token, or a supplier token, when rfq_id is given

name: upload_rfq_file
